description.content: This API retrieves a list of notifications a subscriber can access. [See details](../../docs/definitions/retrieve_notifications/) to learn more about this API. Scopes: au_pub_cert_pexa_subscriber_api_v4_read (non-prod) au_pub_pexa_subscriber_api_v4_read (prod)

query.description:
The notification category the results will return. Each value must be separated with a comma (,) with no spaces.  
If not provided, PEXA will return all notification category types.

The PEXA internal reference for the event. This value must match the last Event Id which was provided in the previous notification response from PEXA.  
Note: If a Last Event Id has yet to be obtained, the value must be 0.  
If the Last Event ID value does not correspond to the Last Event Timestamp recorded in PEXA, an exception will be returned.  
Maximum 19 characters.

The timestamp of the last event previously retrieved which the results will be filtered from (in UTC).  
Note: The Last Event Timestamp is used in conjunction with the Last Event ID for retrieving notifications.  
The Last Event Timestamp value in the request should match the Last Event Timestamp value which was provided in the previous notification response from PEXA.  
If the Last Event Timestamp value does not correspond to the Last Event Id recorded in PEXA, an exception will be returned.

Used to specify the maximum number of notification records to be returned in a single service call.  
PEXA will set an internal threshold for a maximum number of records to be returned.  
If the PEXA threshold is less than the max number of records provided, PEXA will return its threshold number of records (with the More Data flag set to indicate there are more notification records where applicable).  
If no value is provided, the PEXA threshold will be used as the default number for notification records to be received. If a value is provided, it must be greater than 0.

The notification severity the results will return.  
If not provided, PEXA will return all notification severity types.
The PEXA internal reference for the subscriber. <br> Maximum 19 characters

Welcome to our PEXA Exchange API documentation. These APIs cover key facets of PEXA Exchange functionality. PEXA APIs use the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization. They support the following OAuth 2.0 flows: - Client Credentials - Authorization Code Scopes are used to grant an application different levels of access to data. Each API endpoint will require specific scopes. The scopes are listed against each API endpoint. Server URLs: - https://api.pexa.com.au/api/rest (prod) - https://api-tst.pexalabs.com.au/api/rest (non-prod) For more information, see the following guides: - [Authentication](../../docs/documentation/)
